---
applyTo: "frontend/**/*.{js,jsx}"
---

# Frontend Instructions

Use React with Vite.

Use JavaScript and JSX, not TypeScript.

Keep UI components separate from application services.

WebSocket communication belongs in dedicated services/hooks.

Audio recording and playback logic should be isolated from UI components.

Do not put the entire application inside App.jsx.

Reuse existing components and services before creating duplicates.
